confirmed.statement: Read the complete markdown conversion, including references and Appendices A-F, and independently extracted the PDF passages and tables supporting the recorded outcomes.

confirmed.statement: S1-O1 counts unique proposals participants created, using interaction logs rather than self-reports. Fluency, category_count, and scored_on_output=true are supported; the exact rule for distinguishing unique proposals from revisions is not reported, as the form acknowledges.

confirmed.statement: S1-O1 uses participant-level observations: 51 analyzed participants, 17 per condition. Participants produced proposals individually using their assigned AI configuration, supporting AI availability=yes, immediate timing, and question=with_ai.
confirmed.locator: PDF p. 11, Section 5.1; p. 13, Section 5.3.1; p. 14, Table 4; p. 29, Appendix C.2.

confirmed.statement: All three S1-O1 contrasts reproduce Table 4 correctly: Intensive 1.58 (0.77), Medium 1.88 (1.20), Low 2.19 (1.11); F(2, 48)=1.52, p=0.22. The table caption specifies means and standard deviations per hour.
confirmed.locator: PDF p. 14, Table 4, # Unique_research_proposals row and caption.

confirmed.statement: The S1-O1 test is a three-condition omnibus ANOVA, not a pairwise test. Appendix F reports pairwise results only for Prompt_full_proposal and Select_improvements, so the form correctly avoids assigning those intervals or p-values to proposal fluency.
confirmed.locator: PDF p. 12, Section 5.3.1; p. 14, Table 4; p. 30, Appendix F.1; p. 32, Tables 9-10.

confirmed.statement: S2-O1 consists of domain-expert preferences between two drafts of each seed idea, supporting expert_raters, pair, and 10 matched comparisons. The joint proposal-quality judgment supports usefulness; novelty, feasibility, and impact were not reported as separate scores.
confirmed.locator: PDF p. 11, Section 4.1; p. 27, Appendix B.1; p. 28, Table 6; codebook Section 6.

confirmed.statement: All S3-O1 ranks match Table 7 for ideas 11, 12, 13: Ours 3, 2, 2; Deep Research 1, 1, 1; ChatGPT 2, 3, 3; Gemini 4, 4, 4. Lower ranks mean better quality, supporting the recorded contrast directions; no uncertainty or significance tests are reported.

confirmed.statement: S2-O1, S2-O2, and S3-O1 judge initial AI-generated drafts, supporting AI availability=yes. summary: Criterion 3 holds through the logged participant-level count of unique proposals produced with AI available, correctly coded as fluency. The recorded statistics and outcome coding are supported, with pilot quality judgments treated as model-output benchmarks and no additional qualifying outcome identified.
